cohort: The study included 188,880 weighted reproductive-age women in Sub-Saharan Africa who had given birth in the last five years before the survey.
finding: The mean number of ANC visits among reproductive-age women in SSA was 4.08, significantly lower than the WHO recommendation of eight visits, with only 7.3% achieving this target, and this number was influenced by various socioeconomic and demographic factors.
cross-section timing: Data from Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) from 2017-2023, concerning births in the last five years before the survey.
